body:
The policy-validation entry point delegates to a general shell dispatcher instead of the native validation operation. Replace that delegation with fixed argv: `t81 policy validate <path> --json`. Reject unsupported operations/options and invalid file inputs before invoking the backend; preserve filenames as literal arguments.

Refreshes #614's wrapper/test correction. The skill instructions now describe syntax/metadata validation accurately and limit this entry point's advertised capability. Its existing identifier is preserved. The original evidence and broader audit remain in #614. The new harness preserves the inherited HOME rather than overriding it; receipts distinguish fake-backend argv checks from real CLI validation.

**Stacked on #750** (`fix/cli-execution-policy-reconciliation`), which depends on #747. Review #747, then #750, then retarget this PR to main and obtain hosted checks. Main-only workflow filters do not automatically validate the current stacked target.

Fresh local validation on macOS ARM64, Bash 3.2, AppleClang 21, CMake 4.3, Release/C++23:

- **85 wrapper calls pass**: 40 fake-backend, 44 real CLI, one absent-backend check; one additional successful compiled-policy fixture setup gives **86 process receipts**.
- Same current harness with the original wrapper/dispatcher retains failing before-results separately.
- Registered UNIX `t81_skill_policy_boundary_test`: **1/1 pass**; Bash syntax and `git diff --check`: pass.
- Skill quick-validator rejects the inherited `t81_policy_checker` underscore name in both baseline and corrected instructions. This pre-existing naming failure is retained rather than silently renaming an integration identifier.

Checks cover quoted/metacharacter/option-shaped paths, duplicate and unsupported arguments, directories, broken symlinks, FIFOs, unreadable files, native parse errors, compiled policies, exit propagation and persistent filesystem observations. No new standalone workflow is added; the test uses existing UNIX CTest lanes.

Limits: symlinks to readable files remain allowed; no workspace containment, TOCTOU protection, resource sandbox or operation authorization is added. Other wrappers remain outside this correction. Windows/WSL and Linux Bash execution are not locally established. This is implementation regression testing, not independent scientific validation or blanket skill security approval. Original maintainer checkout remains untouched.

### Parent refresh and validation — 2026-11-10
Current parent is refreshed #750 at 1522f14a, including #747 at b18075ad. Wrapper/skill/harness blobs remain unchanged. The preceding refresh passed the registered boundary test with 86 receipts (fixture setup included), real CLI included, zero failed checks. The latest CMake merge retains the CLI, wrapper and new checker registrations. HOME remains inherited. Hosted checks are required after #750 merges and this PR is retargeted.
title: fix(skills): constrain policy validation to literal argv
